sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Secret to Productivity is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, merc. I've been thinking about that torture room you found. I can't believe it was the only thing that kept that thing going. The stick isn't enough, we need a carrot. I'm sure the employees had a way to cheer themselves up and relieve stress. See what else you can find out, maybe you'll find some more info."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Unravel the secret of the IT firm's employees' high morale on Streets of Tarkov
- Survive and extract from the location

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +25,400 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.02
- 174,000 Roubles
  - 182,700 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 200,100 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Pressure gauge
- 3× Silicone tube
"I knew there was more to it than torture. So it's the hookah lounge as well. That's a nice carrot indeed. Here's your reward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| Relaxation room key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks the door to the "Hive" hookah lounge in the Malevicha street no. 5 building on Streets of Tarkov. |
In this quest you have to find and enter the "Hive" hookah lounge in the Malevicha street no. 5 building on Streets of Tarkov. A Relaxation room key is required to access it.

Dying before extracting will reset the first part of this quest.
